name: Doga
summary: Mumbai's dog-masked vigilante and Raj Comics' signature antihero: Suraj, a gym-trained orphan who wages a merciless war on organised crime. Debuted in Curfew (1992).
origin: As a baby, Suraj was found in a garbage dump by the dacoit Halkan Singh, who raised him like a dog among his gang. After escaping, he was taken in by Adrak Chacha, a former weightlifting champion who ran the Lion Gym, and his brothers, who each trained him: Haldi in martial arts, Dhania in boxing and Kalimirchi in sharpshooting. When goons hired by a rival gym owner killed the brothers who trained him, Suraj put on a dog mask, took his revenge and became Doga, hunting Mumbai's gangsters outside the law. He later killed Halkan Singh, who had become a government minister.
powers: Peak strength and stamina from gym training
Expert marksman with a large arsenal

storyline.title: Raised by a dacoit
storyline.beat: Halkan Singh raises the foundling like an animal, and the boy grows up surrounded by crime.

storyline.title: Four spice uncles
storyline.beat: At the Lion Gym, Adrak and his brothers turn Suraj into a fighter, boxer and crack shot.

storyline.title: Curfew
storyline.beat: After his trainers are murdered, Suraj puts on the dog mask and makes his debut in Curfew.

storyline.title: Mumbai's nightmare
storyline.beat: Doga becomes a one-man army against Mumbai's gangs, and eventually kills his abuser Halkan Singh, now a minister.

storyline.title: The film that wasn't
storyline.beat: Anurag Kashyap talks about a Doga film in 2014 but shelves it. Raj Comics later releases its own short film, Doga – Mumbai Ka Rakhwala, on YouTube.

gossip.text: His four trainers are all named after kitchen spices: Adrak (ginger), Haldi (turmeric), Dhania (coriander) and Kalimirchi (black pepper).
Anurag Kashyap planned a Doga film around 2014 but shelved it after Bombay Velvet flopped.
Coverage of the planned film compared Doga to Marvel's Punisher.

gossip.truth: He has no powers at all. It's all training and guns, although he can communicate with dogs and command them.

gossip.text: Sources disagree on who created him. Most credit Tarun Kumar Wahi, Sanjay Gupta and artist Manu, but some name Manish Gupta.

quiz.why: Under the dog mask is Suraj, a foundling raised by the dacoit Halkan Singh.

quiz.q: Doga's four trainers are all named after what?
quiz.why: Adrak, Haldi, Dhania and Kalimirchi are ginger, turmeric, coriander and black pepper.

quiz.q: Which city is Doga's hunting ground?
quiz.why: He wages his war on Mumbai's organised crime.

theme.tagline: Barks at the gangs, bites the system.

timeline.title: Curfew
timeline.note: Raj Comics' first true antihero hits Mumbai in a dog mask, ready to do what the cops won't.

timeline.title: Anurag Kashyap signs on
timeline.note: The Dev D director takes on a live-action Doga film. It stalls in scripting and is later shelved.

timeline.title: Kunal Kapoor cast as Doga
timeline.note: Actor Kunal Kapoor is announced in the role for a planned live-action series. It has not reached screens.

timeline.title: Live-action shorts
timeline.note: Raj Comics launches a live-action short-film series on YouTube that brings Doga and Dhruva to life.
